title: componentLookup operation
description: ONE TOOL CALL, ONE EVIDENCE CARD for a compound: whether the installation catalogue has it (by file name, declared alias or CAS -- never by similarity), which properties its record carries and which are missing, in a fixed byte budget (2048 bytes). A compound only in the group-estimate lake is reported as identity + groups, 'not reviewed', with NO estimated values; otherwise 'I do not have this compound'. The card lists what exists and never prints the values.

component.title: Compound
component.description: A catalogue file name, a declared alias or a CAS number.
